Casey: Heads-up: planning a microthread push for Launch V2 focused on short clips + thread seeding. Need owners for asset QA, headline tests, and routing.
Rowan: I can run the headline A/B and monitor CTRs. Propose A: "Cut inference costs 3x" B: "Ship faster: 95ms p99". Run A in AM, B in PM.
Lin: I'll handle asset QA. Need final clips in 30s and 15s versions + GIF. Also alt text and one-line captions for accessibility.
Zoe: Engagement plan: I'll cover first 90 mins. Reply playbook: 1) thanks + webinar link 2) ask role 3) offer demo. Triage demo interest to `sdr:webinar-warm`.
Priya: Routing: webinar signups -> `sdr:webinar-warm` (tag source=microthread_v2). Demo clickthroughs -> `ae:demo-try`. Make sure UTM params for each channel: x_microthread, ln_microthread.
Casey: Posting cadence idea (PT):
Wed 09:00  X short clip + 3-tweet microthread (benchmark lead)
Wed 09:05  X paid boost (AM)
Wed 11:30  LinkedIn short thread + 3 screenshots
Wed 17:00  X paid boost (PM, headline B)
Rowan: I'll rotate headline after 45m if CTR delta > 15%. Also will surface top replies to Product for quote grabs.
Lin: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/rlw/microthreads/v2 (v2_clip_30.mp4, v2_clip_15.mp4, v2_gif.gif, v2_thumb.png). Alt text added.
Zoe: Also prepping canned replies for common questions: pricing, benchmarks, demo link. Will paste them here by EOD.
Priya: Add tracking pixel & conversion event `webinar_reg` to confirm capture. Ops to verify CRM mapping before go-live.
PostBot: Reminder: calendar slot reserved Wed 09:00 PT (job id: cal_7821).
Casey: Small paid budget approved. Pause boosts if CTR < 0.4% after 1h. Reallocate to LinkedIn if underperforming.
Rowan: Draft microthread (benchmark):
1/ Benchmarks matter: we cut token cost 3x with smarter batching.
2/ p99 latency down from 320ms to 95ms after routing + kv cache.
3/ Want configs? Join our webinar: [link]?utm_campaign=microthread_v2&utm_source=x_microthread
Lin: Proofed copy and captions. Minor edits for char limits applied.
Zoe: Engagement SOP ready. I'll handover to Maya for hour-2 monitoring.
Priya: Ops confirm CRM mapping?
Rowan: Confirmed: UTMs captured, leads flowing to queues.
PostBot: Job queued: cal_7821 scheduled Wed 09:00 PT.
Casey: Great work. If any urgent issues ping me or DM. Closing thread unless blockers.
